capabilities: Draw rectangles, ellipses, diamonds, lines and doodles on a character grid
Select, move, resize, group and reorder elements with per-element visibility and lock
Route grid-snapped lines with arrows, styles and obstacle-aware pathfinding linked to shapes
Embed .unidraw files or code blocks in notes and export to PNG, text or Markdown
Edit rectangle text, fill, border and interrupt features through an inspector panel
disambiguation: Not a vector or image drawing tool; all output is Unicode character art on a fixed character grid.
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Requires Obsidian 1.7.5+; right-click tools need a mouse, so desktop is recommended. No network calls and no bundled fonts or runtime libraries.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in editor for creating or editing Unicode/ASCII character-art diagrams; users must draw them in external tools and paste static text.

relations.evidence: ASCII Canvas by Huseyin Akbas — a minimal ASCII-only canvas plugin
asciiflow — fast keyboard-friendly box-line drawing and smart intersections
the object, element and text workflow of Monodraw

summary: Element-based Unicode character-art studio that draws shapes, smart lines and doodles on a grid canvas, saved as JSON .unidraw files.
